import Mathlib

inductive Node
| mk (val : Int) (is_end : Bool) (left mid right : Option Node)
deriving Inhabited

namespace Node

def val (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with | Node.mk v _ _ _ _ => v

def is_end (t : Node) : Bool :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ b _ _ _ => b

def left (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ l _ _ => l

def mid (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ _ m _ => m

def right (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ _ _ r => r

end Node

def view (t : Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  let l := match t.left with | some child => view child | none => ∅
  let r := match t.right with | some child => view child | none => ∅
  let m := match t.mid with | some child => (view child).image (fun s => t.val :: s) | none => ∅
  let current := if t.is_end then {[t.val]} else ∅
  l ∪ r ∪ m ∪ current
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by all_goals sorry

def is_empty_node (t : Node) : Bool :=
  !t.is_end ∧ t.left.isNone ∧ t.mid.isNone ∧ t.right.isNone

def well_formed (t : Node) : Prop :=
  (0 ≤ t.val ∧ t.val < 256) ∧
  -- Check Left
  (match t.left with 
   | some l => 
       well_formed l ∧ 
       !is_empty_node l ∧ -- CRITICAL: Match Dafny pruning
       (∀ s ∈ view l, match s with | [] => False | c::_ => c < t.val) 
   | none => True) ∧
  -- Check Right
  (match t.right with 
   | some r => 
       well_formed r ∧ 
       !is_empty_node r ∧ -- CRITICAL
       (∀ s ∈ view r, match s with | [] => False | c::_ => c > t.val) 
   | none => True) ∧
  -- Check Mid
  (match t.mid with 
   | some m => 
       well_formed m ∧ 
       !is_empty_node m -- CRITICAL
   | none => True)
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by all_goals sorry

def is_valid_key (key : List Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ k ∈ key, 0 ≤ k ∧ k < 256

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_precond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  (match t with
   | some node => well_formed node ∧ !is_empty_node node
   | none => True) ∧
  is_valid_key key -- Match Dafny input constraint
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

def nodeWeight : Node → Nat
  | Node.mk _ _ l m r =>
      1 +
        (match l with | none => 0 | some n => nodeWeight n) +
        (match m with | none => 0 | some n => nodeWeight n) +
        (match r with | none => 0 | some n => nodeWeight n)

lemma nodeWeight_left_lt
    (v : Int) (e : Bool) (n : Node) (m r : Option Node) :
    nodeWeight n < nodeWeight (Node.mk v e (some n) m r) := by
  have h :
      nodeWeight (Node.mk v e (some n) m r) =
        1 + nodeWeight n +
          (match m with | none => 0 | some x => nodeWeight x) +
          (match r with | none => 0 | some x => nodeWeight x) := by
    rw [nodeWeight.eq_def]
  rw [h]
  omega

lemma nodeWeight_mid_lt
    (v : Int) (e : Bool) (l : Option Node) (n : Node) (r : Option Node) :
    nodeWeight n < nodeWeight (Node.mk v e l (some n) r) := by
  have h :
      nodeWeight (Node.mk v e l (some n) r) =
        1 +
          (match l with | none => 0 | some x => nodeWeight x) +
          nodeWeight n +
          (match r with | none => 0 | some x => nodeWeight x) := by
    rw [nodeWeight.eq_def]
  rw [h]
  omega

lemma nodeWeight_right_lt
    (v : Int) (e : Bool) (l m : Option Node) (n : Node) :
    nodeWeight n < nodeWeight (Node.mk v e l m (some n)) := by
  have h :
      nodeWeight (Node.mk v e l m (some n)) =
        1 +
          (match l with | none => 0 | some x => nodeWeight x) +
          (match m with | none => 0 | some x => nodeWeight x) +
          nodeWeight n := by
    rw [nodeWeight.eq_def]
  rw [h]
  omega

def prune (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  if is_empty_node t then none else some t

def deleteNode : Node → List Int → Option Node
  | t, [] => some t
  | Node.mk v e l m r, k :: ks =>
      if k < v then
        let l' :=
          match l with
          | none => none
          | some child => deleteNode child (k :: ks)
        prune (Node.mk v e l' m r)
      else if v < k then
        let r' :=
          match r with
          | none => none
          | some child => deleteNode child (k :: ks)
        prune (Node.mk v e l m r')
      else
        match ks with
        | [] => prune (Node.mk v false l m r)
        | k' :: ks' =>
            let m' :=
              match m with
              | none => none
              | some child => deleteNode child (k' :: ks')
            prune (Node.mk v e l m' r)
termination_by t => nodeWeight t
decreasing_by
  · exact nodeWeight_left_lt _ _ _ _ _
  · exact nodeWeight_right_lt _ _ _ _ _
  · exact nodeWeight_mid_lt _ _ _ _ _

lemma deleteNode_nil (t : Node) :
    deleteNode t [] = some t := by
  rcases t with ⟨v, e, l, m, r⟩
  rw [deleteNode.eq_def]

lemma deleteNode_cons
    (v : Int) (e : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (k : Int) (ks : List Int) :
    deleteNode (Node.mk v e l m r) (k :: ks) =
      if k < v then
        let l' :=
          match l with
          | none => none
          | some child => deleteNode child (k :: ks)
        prune (Node.mk v e l' m r)
      else if v < k then
        let r' :=
          match r with
          | none => none
          | some child => deleteNode child (k :: ks)
        prune (Node.mk v e l m r')
      else
        match ks with
        | [] => prune (Node.mk v false l m r)
        | k' :: ks' =>
            let m' :=
              match m with
              | none => none
              | some child => deleteNode child (k' :: ks')
            prune (Node.mk v e l m' r) := by
  rw [deleteNode.eq_def]

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def delete (t : Option Node) (key : List Int)
    (h_precond : delete_precond t key) : Option Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  match t with
  | none => none
  | some node => deleteNode node key
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- View wrapper for Option Node
def view_opt (t : Option Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  match t with
  | some node => view node
  | none => ∅

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_postcond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) (result : Option Node)
    (_ : delete_precond t key) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  (match result with
   | some res => well_formed res ∧ !is_empty_node res
   | none => True) ∧
  view_opt result = view_opt t \ {key}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

def good_opt : Option Node → Prop
  | none => True
  | some n => well_formed n ∧ !is_empty_node n

def below (o : Option Node) (v : Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ s ∈ view_opt o,
    match s with
    | [] => False
    | c :: _ => c < v

def above (o : Option Node) (v : Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ s ∈ view_opt o,
    match s with
    | [] => False
    | c :: _ => c > v

def prefixView (v : Int) (o : Option Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  Set.image (fun s : List Int => v :: s) (view_opt o)

@[simp]
lemma view_opt_none : view_opt none = ∅ := rfl

@[simp]
lemma view_opt_some (n : Node) : view_opt (some n) = view n := rfl

lemma view_mk (v : Int) (e : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    view (Node.mk v e l m r) =
      ((view_opt l ∪ view_opt r) ∪ prefixView v m) ∪
        (if e then {[v]} else ∅) := by
  rw [view.eq_def]
  simp only [Node.left, Node.right, Node.mid, Node.val, Node.is_end]
  unfold prefixView view_opt
  cases m <;> simp only [Set.image_empty]

lemma wf_mk (v : Int) (e : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    well_formed (Node.mk v e l m r) ↔
      (0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256) ∧
      (good_opt l ∧ below l v) ∧
      (good_opt r ∧ above r v) ∧
      good_opt m := by
  rw [well_formed.eq_def]
  simp only [Node.val, Node.left, Node.right, Node.mid]
  cases l <;> cases m <;> cases r <;>
    simp only [good_opt, below, above, view_opt]
  all_goals tauto

lemma empty_node_mk_iff
    (v : Int) (e : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    is_empty_node (Node.mk v e l m r) ↔
      e = false ∧ l = none ∧ m = none ∧ r = none := by
  simp only [is_empty_node, Node.is_end, Node.left, Node.mid, Node.right]
  cases e <;> cases l <;> cases m <;> cases r <;> simp

lemma view_eq_empty_of_empty_node (n : Node)
    (h : is_empty_node n) :
    view n = ∅ := by
  rcases n with ⟨v, e, l, m, r⟩
  rw [empty_node_mk_iff] at h
  rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  rw [view_mk]
  simp [prefixView]

lemma prune_spec (n : Node) (hn : well_formed n) :
    good_opt (prune n) ∧ view_opt (prune n) = view n := by
  by_cases h : is_empty_node n
  · have hv : view n = ∅ := view_eq_empty_of_empty_node n h
    simp [prune, h, good_opt, hv]
  · simp [prune, h, good_opt, hn]

lemma valid_key_tail {k : Int} {ks : List Int}
    (h : is_valid_key (k :: ks)) :
    is_valid_key ks := by
  intro x hx
  exact h x (by simp [hx])

lemma below_mono {a b : Option Node} {v : Int}
    (hb : below b v) (hsub : view_opt a ⊆ view_opt b) :
    below a v := by
  intro s hs
  exact hb s (hsub hs)

lemma above_mono {a b : Option Node} {v : Int}
    (hb : above b v) (hsub : view_opt a ⊆ view_opt b) :
    above a v := by
  intro s hs
  exact hb s (hsub hs)

lemma diff_subset_self (S : Set (List Int)) (q : List Int) :
    S \ {q} ⊆ S := by
  intro x hx
  exact hx.1

lemma replace_left
    (A A' B C D : Set (List Int)) (q : List Int)
    (hA : A' = A \ {q})
    (hB : q ∉ B) (hC : q ∉ C) (hD : q ∉ D) :
    ((A' ∪ B) ∪ C) ∪ D =
      (((A ∪ B) ∪ C) ∪ D) \ {q} := by
  subst A'
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  aesop

lemma replace_right
    (A B B' C D : Set (List Int)) (q : List Int)
    (hB : B' = B \ {q})
    (hA : q ∉ A) (hC : q ∉ C) (hD : q ∉ D) :
    ((A ∪ B') ∪ C) ∪ D =
      (((A ∪ B) ∪ C) ∪ D) \ {q} := by
  subst B'
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  aesop

lemma replace_mid
    (A B C C' D : Set (List Int)) (q : List Int)
    (hC : C' = C \ {q})
    (hA : q ∉ A) (hB : q ∉ B) (hD : q ∉ D) :
    ((A ∪ B) ∪ C') ∪ D =
      (((A ∪ B) ∪ C) ∪ D) \ {q} := by
  subst C'
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  aesop

lemma replace_current
    (A B C D D' : Set (List Int)) (q : List Int)
    (hD : D' = D \ {q})
    (hA : q ∉ A) (hB : q ∉ B) (hC : q ∉ C) :
    ((A ∪ B) ∪ C) ∪ D' =
      (((A ∪ B) ∪ C) ∪ D) \ {q} := by
  subst D'
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  aesop

lemma prefix_diff
    (v : Int) (old new : Option Node) (q : List Int)
    (h : view_opt new = view_opt old \ {q}) :
    prefixView v new =
      prefixView v old \ {v :: q} := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hx' :
        x ∈ Set.image (fun s : List Int => v :: s) (view_opt new) := hx
    rcases hx' with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rw [h] at hy
    refine ⟨⟨y, hy.1, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    intro heq
    exact hy.2 (List.cons.inj heq).2
  · intro hx
    have hx' :
        x ∈
          Set.image (fun s : List Int => v :: s) (view_opt old) \
            ({v :: q} : Set (List Int)) := hx
    rcases hx' with ⟨⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, hne⟩
    change v :: y ∈ Set.image (fun s : List Int => v :: s) (view_opt new)
    refine ⟨y, ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [h]
    refine ⟨hy, ?_⟩
    intro hyq
    subst y
    exact hne rfl

lemma nil_not_mem_view_of_wf (n : Node)
    (hn : well_formed n) :
    [] ∉ view n := by
  rcases n with ⟨v, e, l, m, r⟩
  have hw := (wf_mk v e l m r).mp hn
  rw [view_mk]
  intro hs
  rcases hs with hABCM | hcur
  · rcases hABCM with hAB | hm
    · rcases hAB with hl | hr
      · exact hw.2.1.2 [] hl
      · exact hw.2.2.1.2 [] hr
    · have hm' :
          [] ∈ Set.image (fun s : List Int => v :: s) (view_opt m) := hm
      rcases hm' with ⟨x, _, hx⟩
      exact List.noConfusion hx
  · cases e <;> simp at hcur

lemma deleteNode_spec (t : Node) (key : List Int)
    (ht : well_formed t) (hne : !is_empty_node t)
    (hk : is_valid_key key) :
    good_opt (deleteNode t key) ∧
      view_opt (deleteNode t key) = view t \ {key} := by
  induction t using (measure nodeWeight).wf.induction generalizing key with
  | h t ih =>
      rcases t with ⟨v, e, l, m, r⟩
      have hw := (wf_mk v e l m r).mp ht
      cases key with
      | nil =>
          rw [deleteNode_nil]
          constructor
          · exact ⟨ht, hne⟩
          · ext s
            simp only [view_opt_some, Set.mem_diff,
              Set.mem_singleton_iff]
            constructor
            · intro hs
              refine ⟨hs, ?_⟩
              intro hs0
              subst s
              exact nil_not_mem_view_of_wf
                (Node.mk v e l m r) ht hs
            · intro hs
              exact hs.1

      | cons k ks =>
          have hks : is_valid_key ks := valid_key_tail hk
          by_cases hkv : k < v
          · let l' :=
              match l with
              | none => none
              | some child => deleteNode child (k :: ks)

            have hl :
                good_opt l' ∧
                  view_opt l' = view_opt l \ {k :: ks} := by
              cases l with
              | none =>
                  constructor
                  · trivial
                  · change
                      (∅ : Set (List Int)) =
                        (∅ : Set (List Int)) \ {k :: ks}
                    ext x
                    simp
              | some child =>
                  have hc := hw.2.1.1
                  have hrec :=
                    ih child (nodeWeight_left_lt v e child m r)
                      (k :: ks) hc.1 hc.2 hk
                  simpa [l'] using hrec

            have hlBelow : below l' v := by
              apply below_mono hw.2.1.2
              rw [hl.2]
              exact diff_subset_self _ _

            let n := Node.mk v e l' m r
            have hnwf : well_formed n := by
              apply (wf_mk v e l' m r).mpr
              exact ⟨hw.1, ⟨hl.1, hlBelow⟩, hw.2.2.1, hw.2.2.2⟩

            have hR : k :: ks ∉ view_opt r := by
              intro hs
              have ho := hw.2.2.1.2 (k :: ks) hs
              change k > v at ho
              omega

            have hM : k :: ks ∉ prefixView v m := by
              intro hs
              have hs' :
                  k :: ks ∈
                    Set.image (fun s : List Int => v :: s) (view_opt m) := hs
              rcases hs' with ⟨x, _, heq⟩
              have heq' : k = v := (List.cons.inj heq).1.symm
              omega

            have hC :
                k :: ks ∉
                  (if e then ({[v]} : Set (List Int))
                   else (∅ : Set (List Int))) := by
              cases e with
              | false => exact Set.notMem_empty _
              | true =>
                  simp only [if_true, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
                  intro heq
                  have heq' : k = v := (List.cons.inj heq).1
                  omega

            have hnview :
                view n = view (Node.mk v e l m r) \ {k :: ks} := by
              rw [view_mk, view_mk]
              exact replace_left
                (view_opt l) (view_opt l') (view_opt r)
                (prefixView v m) (if e then {[v]} else ∅)
                (k :: ks) hl.2 hR hM hC

            have hp := prune_spec n hnwf
            rw [deleteNode_cons, if_pos hkv]
            change
              good_opt (prune n) ∧
                view_opt (prune n) =
                  view (Node.mk v e l m r) \ {k :: ks}
            exact ⟨hp.1, hp.2.trans hnview⟩

          · by_cases hvk : v < k
            · let r' :=
                match r with
                | none => none
                | some child => deleteNode child (k :: ks)

              have hr :
                  good_opt r' ∧
                    view_opt r' = view_opt r \ {k :: ks} := by
                cases r with
                | none =>
                    constructor
                    · trivial
                    · change
                        (∅ : Set (List Int)) =
                          (∅ : Set (List Int)) \ {k :: ks}
                      ext x
                      simp
                | some child =>
                    have hc := hw.2.2.1.1
                    have hrec :=
                      ih child (nodeWeight_right_lt v e l m child)
                        (k :: ks) hc.1 hc.2 hk
                    simpa [r'] using hrec

              have hrAbove : above r' v := by
                apply above_mono hw.2.2.1.2
                rw [hr.2]
                exact diff_subset_self _ _

              let n := Node.mk v e l m r'
              have hnwf : well_formed n := by
                apply (wf_mk v e l m r').mpr
                exact ⟨hw.1, hw.2.1, ⟨hr.1, hrAbove⟩, hw.2.2.2⟩

              have hL : k :: ks ∉ view_opt l := by
                intro hs
                have ho := hw.2.1.2 (k :: ks) hs
                change k < v at ho
                omega

              have hM : k :: ks ∉ prefixView v m := by
                intro hs
                have hs' :
                    k :: ks ∈
                      Set.image (fun s : List Int => v :: s) (view_opt m) := hs
                rcases hs' with ⟨x, _, heq⟩
                have heq' : k = v := (List.cons.inj heq).1.symm
                omega

              have hC :
                  k :: ks ∉
                    (if e then ({[v]} : Set (List Int))
                     else (∅ : Set (List Int))) := by
                cases e with
                | false => exact Set.notMem_empty _
                | true =>
                    simp only [if_true, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
                    intro heq
                    have heq' : k = v := (List.cons.inj heq).1
                    omega

              have hnview :
                  view n = view (Node.mk v e l m r) \ {k :: ks} := by
                rw [view_mk, view_mk]
                exact replace_right
                  (view_opt l) (view_opt r) (view_opt r')
                  (prefixView v m) (if e then {[v]} else ∅)
                  (k :: ks) hr.2 hL hM hC

              have hp := prune_spec n hnwf
              rw [deleteNode_cons, if_neg hkv, if_pos hvk]
              change
                good_opt (prune n) ∧
                  view_opt (prune n) =
                    view (Node.mk v e l m r) \ {k :: ks}
              exact ⟨hp.1, hp.2.trans hnview⟩

            · have hkeq : k = v := by omega
              subst k
              cases ks with
              | nil =>
                  let n := Node.mk v false l m r

                  have hnwf : well_formed n := by
                    apply (wf_mk v false l m r).mpr
                    exact hw

                  have hL : [v] ∉ view_opt l := by
                    intro hs
                    have ho := hw.2.1.2 [v] hs
                    change v < v at ho
                    omega

                  have hR : [v] ∉ view_opt r := by
                    intro hs
                    have ho := hw.2.2.1.2 [v] hs
                    change v > v at ho
                    omega

                  have hM : [v] ∉ prefixView v m := by
                    intro hs
                    have hs' :
                        [v] ∈ Set.image
                          (fun s : List Int => v :: s) (view_opt m) := hs
                    rcases hs' with ⟨x, hx, heq⟩
                    have hxnil : x = [] := (List.cons.inj heq).2
                    subst x
                    cases m with
                    | none => exact Set.notMem_empty [] hx
                    | some child =>
                        exact nil_not_mem_view_of_wf child
                          hw.2.2.2.1 hx

                  have hcurrent :
                      (∅ : Set (List Int)) =
                        (if e then {[v]} else ∅) \ {[v]} := by
                    cases e <;> simp

                  have hnview :
                      view n = view (Node.mk v e l m r) \ {[v]} := by
                    rw [view_mk, view_mk]
                    exact replace_current
                      (view_opt l) (view_opt r) (prefixView v m)
                      (if e then {[v]} else ∅) ∅ [v]
                      hcurrent hL hR hM

                  have hp := prune_spec n hnwf
                  rw [deleteNode_cons, if_neg hkv, if_neg hvk]
                  change
                    good_opt (prune n) ∧
                      view_opt (prune n) =
                        view (Node.mk v e l m r) \ {[v]}
                  exact ⟨hp.1, hp.2.trans hnview⟩

              | cons k' ks' =>
                  let m' :=
                    match m with
                    | none => none
                    | some child => deleteNode child (k' :: ks')

                  have hm :
                      good_opt m' ∧
                        view_opt m' = view_opt m \ {k' :: ks'} := by
                    cases m with
                    | none =>
                        constructor
                        · trivial
                        · change
                            (∅ : Set (List Int)) =
                              (∅ : Set (List Int)) \ {k' :: ks'}
                          ext x
                          simp
                    | some child =>
                        have hc := hw.2.2.2
                        have hrec :=
                          ih child (nodeWeight_mid_lt v e l child r)
                            (k' :: ks') hc.1 hc.2 hks
                        simpa [m'] using hrec

                  let n := Node.mk v e l m' r
                  have hnwf : well_formed n := by
                    apply (wf_mk v e l m' r).mpr
                    exact ⟨hw.1, hw.2.1, hw.2.2.1, hm.1⟩

                  have hprefix :
                      prefixView v m' =
                        prefixView v m \ {v :: k' :: ks'} :=
                    prefix_diff v m m' (k' :: ks') hm.2

                  have hL :
                      v :: k' :: ks' ∉ view_opt l := by
                    intro hs
                    have ho := hw.2.1.2 (v :: k' :: ks') hs
                    change v < v at ho
                    omega

                  have hR :
                      v :: k' :: ks' ∉ view_opt r := by
                    intro hs
                    have ho := hw.2.2.1.2 (v :: k' :: ks') hs
                    change v > v at ho
                    omega

                  have hC :
                      v :: k' :: ks' ∉

| mk (val : Int) (is_end : Bool) (left mid right : Option Node)
deriving Inhabited

namespace Node

def val (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with | Node.mk v _ _ _ _ => v

def is_end (t : Node) : Bool :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ b _ _ _ => b

def left (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ l _ _ => l

def mid (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ _ m _ => m

def right (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ _ _ r => r

end Node

def view (t : Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  let l := match t.left with | some child => view child | none => ∅
  let r := match t.right with | some child => view child | none => ∅
  let m := match t.mid with | some child => (view child).image (fun s => t.val :: s) | none => ∅
  let current := if t.is_end then {[t.val]} else ∅
  l ∪ r ∪ m ∪ current
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by all_goals sorry

def is_empty_node (t : Node) : Bool :=
  !t.is_end ∧ t.left.isNone ∧ t.mid.isNone ∧ t.right.isNone

def well_formed (t : Node) : Prop :=
  (0 ≤ t.val ∧ t.val < 256) ∧
  -- Check Left
  (match t.left with 
   | some l => 
       well_formed l ∧ 
       !is_empty_node l ∧ -- CRITICAL: Match Dafny pruning
       (∀ s ∈ view l, match s with | [] => False | c::_ => c < t.val) 
   | none => True) ∧
  -- Check Right
  (match t.right with 
   | some r => 
       well_formed r ∧ 
       !is_empty_node r ∧ -- CRITICAL
       (∀ s ∈ view r, match s with | [] => False | c::_ => c > t.val) 
   | none => True) ∧
  -- Check Mid
  (match t.mid with 
   | some m => 
       well_formed m ∧ 
       !is_empty_node m -- CRITICAL
   | none => True)
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by all_goals sorry

def is_valid_key (key : List Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ k ∈ key, 0 ≤ k ∧ k < 256

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_precond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  (match t with
   | some node => well_formed node ∧ !is_empty_node node
   | none => True) ∧
  is_valid_key key -- Match Dafny input constraint
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

def nodeWeight : Node → Nat
  | Node.mk _ _ l m r =>
      1 +
        (match l with | none => 0 | some n => nodeWeight n) +
        (match m with | none => 0 | some n => nodeWeight n) +
        (match r with | none => 0 | some n => nodeWeight n)

lemma nodeWeight_left_lt
    (v : Int) (e : Bool) (n : Node) (m r : Option Node) :
    nodeWeight n < nodeWeight (Node.mk v e (some n) m r) := by
  have h :
      nodeWeight (Node.mk v e (some n) m r) =
        1 + nodeWeight n +
          (match m with | none => 0 | some x => nodeWeight x) +
          (match r with | none => 0 | some x => nodeWeight x) := by
    rw [nodeWeight.eq_def]
  rw [h]
  omega

lemma nodeWeight_mid_lt
    (v : Int) (e : Bool) (l : Option Node) (n : Node) (r : Option Node) :
    nodeWeight n < nodeWeight (Node.mk v e l (some n) r) := by
  have h :
      nodeWeight (Node.mk v e l (some n) r) =
        1 +
          (match l with | none => 0 | some x => nodeWeight x) +
          nodeWeight n +
          (match r with | none => 0 | some x => nodeWeight x) := by
    rw [nodeWeight.eq_def]
  rw [h]
  omega

lemma nodeWeight_right_lt
    (v : Int) (e : Bool) (l m : Option Node) (n : Node) :
    nodeWeight n < nodeWeight (Node.mk v e l m (some n)) := by
  have h :
      nodeWeight (Node.mk v e l m (some n)) =
        1 +
          (match l with | none => 0 | some x => nodeWeight x) +
          (match m with | none => 0 | some x => nodeWeight x) +
          nodeWeight n := by
    rw [nodeWeight.eq_def]
  rw [h]
  omega

def prune (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  if is_empty_node t then none else some t

def deleteNode : Node → List Int → Option Node
  | t, [] => some t
  | Node.mk v e l m r, k :: ks =>
      if k < v then
        let l' :=
          match l with
          | none => none
          | some child => deleteNode child (k :: ks)
        prune (Node.mk v e l' m r)
      else if v < k then
        let r' :=
          match r with
          | none => none
          | some child => deleteNode child (k :: ks)
        prune (Node.mk v e l m r')
      else
        match ks with
        | [] => prune (Node.mk v false l m r)
        | k' :: ks' =>
            let m' :=
              match m with
              | none => none
              | some child => deleteNode child (k' :: ks')
            prune (Node.mk v e l m' r)
termination_by t => nodeWeight t
decreasing_by
  · exact nodeWeight_left_lt _ _ _ _ _
  · exact nodeWeight_right_lt _ _ _ _ _
  · exact nodeWeight_mid_lt _ _ _ _ _

lemma deleteNode_nil (t : Node) :
    deleteNode t [] = some t := by
  rcases t with ⟨v, e, l, m, r⟩
  rw [deleteNode.eq_def]

lemma deleteNode_cons
    (v : Int) (e : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (k : Int) (ks : List Int) :
    deleteNode (Node.mk v e l m r) (k :: ks) =
      if k < v then
        let l' :=
          match l with
          | none => none
          | some child => deleteNode child (k :: ks)
        prune (Node.mk v e l' m r)
      else if v < k then
        let r' :=
          match r with
          | none => none
          | some child => deleteNode child (k :: ks)
        prune (Node.mk v e l m r')
      else
        match ks with
        | [] => prune (Node.mk v false l m r)
        | k' :: ks' =>
            let m' :=
              match m with
              | none => none
              | some child => deleteNode child (k' :: ks')
            prune (Node.mk v e l m' r) := by
  rw [deleteNode.eq_def]

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def delete (t : Option Node) (key : List Int)
    (h_precond : delete_precond t key) : Option Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  match t with
  | none => none
  | some node => deleteNode node key
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- View wrapper for Option Node
def view_opt (t : Option Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  match t with
  | some node => view node
  | none => ∅

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_postcond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) (result : Option Node)
    (_ : delete_precond t key) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  (match result with
   | some res => well_formed res ∧ !is_empty_node res
   | none => True) ∧
  view_opt result = view_opt t \ {key}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

def good_opt : Option Node → Prop
  | none => True
  | some n => well_formed n ∧ !is_empty_node n

def below (o : Option Node) (v : Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ s ∈ view_opt o,
    match s with
    | [] => False
    | c :: _ => c < v

def above (o : Option Node) (v : Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ s ∈ view_opt o,
    match s with
    | [] => False
    | c :: _ => c > v

def prefixView (v : Int) (o : Option Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  Set.image (fun s : List Int => v :: s) (view_opt o)

@[simp]
lemma view_opt_none : view_opt none = ∅ := rfl

@[simp]
lemma view_opt_some (n : Node) : view_opt (some n) = view n := rfl

lemma view_mk (v : Int) (e : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    view (Node.mk v e l m r) =
      ((view_opt l ∪ view_opt r) ∪ prefixView v m) ∪
        (if e then {[v]} else ∅) := by
  rw [view.eq_def]
  simp only [Node.left, Node.right, Node.mid, Node.val, Node.is_end]
  unfold prefixView view_opt
  cases m <;> simp only [Set.image_empty]

lemma wf_mk (v : Int) (e : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    well_formed (Node.mk v e l m r) ↔
      (0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256) ∧
      (good_opt l ∧ below l v) ∧
      (good_opt r ∧ above r v) ∧
      good_opt m := by
  rw [well_formed.eq_def]
  simp only [Node.val, Node.left, Node.right, Node.mid]
  cases l <;> cases m <;> cases r <;>
    simp only [good_opt, below, above, view_opt]
  all_goals tauto

lemma empty_node_mk_iff
    (v : Int) (e : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    is_empty_node (Node.mk v e l m r) ↔
      e = false ∧ l = none ∧ m = none ∧ r = none := by
  simp only [is_empty_node, Node.is_end, Node.left, Node.mid, Node.right]
  cases e <;> cases l <;> cases m <;> cases r <;> simp

lemma view_eq_empty_of_empty_node (n : Node)
    (h : is_empty_node n) :
    view n = ∅ := by
  rcases n with ⟨v, e, l, m, r⟩
  rw [empty_node_mk_iff] at h
  rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  rw [view_mk]
  simp [prefixView]

lemma prune_spec (n : Node) (hn : well_formed n) :
    good_opt (prune n) ∧ view_opt (prune n) = view n := by
  by_cases h : is_empty_node n
  · have hv : view n = ∅ := view_eq_empty_of_empty_node n h
    simp [prune, h, good_opt, hv]
  · simp [prune, h, good_opt, hn]

lemma valid_key_tail {k : Int} {ks : List Int}
    (h : is_valid_key (k :: ks)) :
    is_valid_key ks := by
  intro x hx
  exact h x (by simp [hx])

lemma below_mono {a b : Option Node} {v : Int}
    (hb : below b v) (hsub : view_opt a ⊆ view_opt b) :
    below a v := by
  intro s hs
  exact hb s (hsub hs)

lemma above_mono {a b : Option Node} {v : Int}
    (hb : above b v) (hsub : view_opt a ⊆ view_opt b) :
    above a v := by
  intro s hs
  exact hb s (hsub hs)

lemma diff_subset_self (S : Set (List Int)) (q : List Int) :
    S \ {q} ⊆ S := by
  intro x hx
  exact hx.1

lemma replace_left
    (A A' B C D : Set (List Int)) (q : List Int)
    (hA : A' = A \ {q})
    (hB : q ∉ B) (hC : q ∉ C) (hD : q ∉ D) :
    ((A' ∪ B) ∪ C) ∪ D =
      (((A ∪ B) ∪ C) ∪ D) \ {q} := by
  subst A'
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  aesop

lemma replace_right
    (A B B' C D : Set (List Int)) (q : List Int)
    (hB : B' = B \ {q})
    (hA : q ∉ A) (hC : q ∉ C) (hD : q ∉ D) :
    ((A ∪ B') ∪ C) ∪ D =
      (((A ∪ B) ∪ C) ∪ D) \ {q} := by
  subst B'
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  aesop

lemma replace_mid
    (A B C C' D : Set (List Int)) (q : List Int)
    (hC : C' = C \ {q})
    (hA : q ∉ A) (hB : q ∉ B) (hD : q ∉ D) :
    ((A ∪ B) ∪ C') ∪ D =
      (((A ∪ B) ∪ C) ∪ D) \ {q} := by
  subst C'
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  aesop

lemma replace_current
    (A B C D D' : Set (List Int)) (q : List Int)
    (hD : D' = D \ {q})
    (hA : q ∉ A) (hB : q ∉ B) (hC : q ∉ C) :
    ((A ∪ B) ∪ C) ∪ D' =
      (((A ∪ B) ∪ C) ∪ D) \ {q} := by
  subst D'
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  aesop

lemma prefix_diff
    (v : Int) (old new : Option Node) (q : List Int)
    (h : view_opt new = view_opt old \ {q}) :
    prefixView v new =
      prefixView v old \ {v :: q} := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hx' :
        x ∈ Set.image (fun s : List Int => v :: s) (view_opt new) := hx
    rcases hx' with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rw [h] at hy
    refine ⟨⟨y, hy.1, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    intro heq
    exact hy.2 (List.cons.inj heq).2
  · intro hx
    have hx' :
        x ∈
          Set.image (fun s : List Int => v :: s) (view_opt old) \
            ({v :: q} : Set (List Int)) := hx
    rcases hx' with ⟨⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, hne⟩
    change v :: y ∈ Set.image (fun s : List Int => v :: s) (view_opt new)
    refine ⟨y, ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [h]
    refine ⟨hy, ?_⟩
    intro hyq
    subst y
    exact hne rfl

lemma nil_not_mem_view_of_wf (n : Node)
    (hn : well_formed n) :
    [] ∉ view n := by
  rcases n with ⟨v, e, l, m, r⟩
  have hw := (wf_mk v e l m r).mp hn
  rw [view_mk]
  intro hs
  rcases hs with hABCM | hcur
  · rcases hABCM with hAB | hm
    · rcases hAB with hl | hr
      · exact hw.2.1.2 [] hl
      · exact hw.2.2.1.2 [] hr
    · have hm' :
          [] ∈ Set.image (fun s : List Int => v :: s) (view_opt m) := hm
      rcases hm' with ⟨x, _, hx⟩
      exact List.noConfusion hx
  · cases e <;> simp at hcur

lemma deleteNode_spec (t : Node) (key : List Int)
    (ht : well_formed t) (hne : !is_empty_node t)
    (hk : is_valid_key key) :
    good_opt (deleteNode t key) ∧
      view_opt (deleteNode t key) = view t \ {key} := by
  induction t using (measure nodeWeight).wf.induction generalizing key with
  | h t ih =>
      rcases t with ⟨v, e, l, m, r⟩
      have hw := (wf_mk v e l m r).mp ht
      cases key with
      | nil =>
          rw [deleteNode_nil]
          constructor
          · exact ⟨ht, hne⟩
          · ext s
            simp only [view_opt_some, Set.mem_diff,
              Set.mem_singleton_iff]
            constructor
            · intro hs
              refine ⟨hs, ?_⟩
              intro hs0
              subst s
              exact nil_not_mem_view_of_wf
                (Node.mk v e l m r) ht hs
            · intro hs
              exact hs.1

      | cons k ks =>
          have hks : is_valid_key ks := valid_key_tail hk
          by_cases hkv : k < v
          · let l' :=
              match l with
              | none => none
              | some child => deleteNode child (k :: ks)

            have hl :
                good_opt l' ∧
                  view_opt l' = view_opt l \ {k :: ks} := by
              cases l with
              | none =>
                  constructor
                  · trivial
                  · change
                      (∅ : Set (List Int)) =
                        (∅ : Set (List Int)) \ {k :: ks}
                    ext x
                    simp
              | some child =>
                  have hc := hw.2.1.1
                  have hrec :=
                    ih child (nodeWeight_left_lt v e child m r)
                      (k :: ks) hc.1 hc.2 hk
                  simpa [l'] using hrec

            have hlBelow : below l' v := by
              apply below_mono hw.2.1.2
              rw [hl.2]
              exact diff_subset_self _ _

            let n := Node.mk v e l' m r
            have hnwf : well_formed n := by
              apply (wf_mk v e l' m r).mpr
              exact ⟨hw.1, ⟨hl.1, hlBelow⟩, hw.2.2.1, hw.2.2.2⟩

            have hR : k :: ks ∉ view_opt r := by
              intro hs
              have ho := hw.2.2.1.2 (k :: ks) hs
              change k > v at ho
              omega

            have hM : k :: ks ∉ prefixView v m := by
              intro hs
              have hs' :
                  k :: ks ∈
                    Set.image (fun s : List Int => v :: s) (view_opt m) := hs
              rcases hs' with ⟨x, _, heq⟩
              have heq' : k = v := (List.cons.inj heq).1.symm
              omega

            have hC :
                k :: ks ∉
                  (if e then ({[v]} : Set (List Int))
                   else (∅ : Set (List Int))) := by
              cases e with
              | false => exact Set.notMem_empty _
              | true =>
                  simp only [if_true, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
                  intro heq
                  have heq' : k = v := (List.cons.inj heq).1
                  omega

            have hnview :
                view n = view (Node.mk v e l m r) \ {k :: ks} := by
              rw [view_mk, view_mk]
              exact replace_left
                (view_opt l) (view_opt l') (view_opt r)
                (prefixView v m) (if e then {[v]} else ∅)
                (k :: ks) hl.2 hR hM hC

            have hp := prune_spec n hnwf
            rw [deleteNode_cons, if_pos hkv]
            change
              good_opt (prune n) ∧
                view_opt (prune n) =
                  view (Node.mk v e l m r) \ {k :: ks}
            exact ⟨hp.1, hp.2.trans hnview⟩

          · by_cases hvk : v < k
            · let r' :=
                match r with
                | none => none
                | some child => deleteNode child (k :: ks)

              have hr :
                  good_opt r' ∧
                    view_opt r' = view_opt r \ {k :: ks} := by
                cases r with
                | none =>
                    constructor
                    · trivial
                    · change
                        (∅ : Set (List Int)) =
                          (∅ : Set (List Int)) \ {k :: ks}
                      ext x
                      simp
                | some child =>
                    have hc := hw.2.2.1.1
                    have hrec :=
                      ih child (nodeWeight_right_lt v e l m child)
                        (k :: ks) hc.1 hc.2 hk
                    simpa [r'] using hrec

              have hrAbove : above r' v := by
                apply above_mono hw.2.2.1.2
                rw [hr.2]
                exact diff_subset_self _ _

              let n := Node.mk v e l m r'
              have hnwf : well_formed n := by
                apply (wf_mk v e l m r').mpr
                exact ⟨hw.1, hw.2.1, ⟨hr.1, hrAbove⟩, hw.2.2.2⟩

              have hL : k :: ks ∉ view_opt l := by
                intro hs
                have ho := hw.2.1.2 (k :: ks) hs
                change k < v at ho
                omega

              have hM : k :: ks ∉ prefixView v m := by
                intro hs
                have hs' :
                    k :: ks ∈
                      Set.image (fun s : List Int => v :: s) (view_opt m) := hs
                rcases hs' with ⟨x, _, heq⟩
                have heq' : k = v := (List.cons.inj heq).1.symm
                omega

              have hC :
                  k :: ks ∉
                    (if e then ({[v]} : Set (List Int))
                     else (∅ : Set (List Int))) := by
                cases e with
                | false => exact Set.notMem_empty _
                | true =>
                    simp only [if_true, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
                    intro heq
                    have heq' : k = v := (List.cons.inj heq).1
                    omega

              have hnview :
                  view n = view (Node.mk v e l m r) \ {k :: ks} := by
                rw [view_mk, view_mk]
                exact replace_right
                  (view_opt l) (view_opt r) (view_opt r')
                  (prefixView v m) (if e then {[v]} else ∅)
                  (k :: ks) hr.2 hL hM hC

              have hp := prune_spec n hnwf
              rw [deleteNode_cons, if_neg hkv, if_pos hvk]
              change
                good_opt (prune n) ∧
                  view_opt (prune n) =
                    view (Node.mk v e l m r) \ {k :: ks}
              exact ⟨hp.1, hp.2.trans hnview⟩

            · have hkeq : k = v := by omega
              subst k
              cases ks with
              | nil =>
                  let n := Node.mk v false l m r

                  have hnwf : well_formed n := by
                    apply (wf_mk v false l m r).mpr
                    exact hw

                  have hL : [v] ∉ view_opt l := by
                    intro hs
                    have ho := hw.2.1.2 [v] hs
                    change v < v at ho
                    omega

                  have hR : [v] ∉ view_opt r := by
                    intro hs
                    have ho := hw.2.2.1.2 [v] hs
                    change v > v at ho
                    omega

                  have hM : [v] ∉ prefixView v m := by
                    intro hs
                    have hs' :
                        [v] ∈ Set.image
                          (fun s : List Int => v :: s) (view_opt m) := hs
                    rcases hs' with ⟨x, hx, heq⟩
                    have hxnil : x = [] := (List.cons.inj heq).2
                    subst x
                    cases m with
                    | none => exact Set.notMem_empty [] hx
                    | some child =>
                        exact nil_not_mem_view_of_wf child
                          hw.2.2.2.1 hx

                  have hcurrent :
                      (∅ : Set (List Int)) =
                        (if e then {[v]} else ∅) \ {[v]} := by
                    cases e <;> simp

                  have hnview :
                      view n = view (Node.mk v e l m r) \ {[v]} := by
                    rw [view_mk, view_mk]
                    exact replace_current
                      (view_opt l) (view_opt r) (prefixView v m)
                      (if e then {[v]} else ∅) ∅ [v]
                      hcurrent hL hR hM

                  have hp := prune_spec n hnwf
                  rw [deleteNode_cons, if_neg hkv, if_neg hvk]
                  change
                    good_opt (prune n) ∧
                      view_opt (prune n) =
                        view (Node.mk v e l m r) \ {[v]}
                  exact ⟨hp.1, hp.2.trans hnview⟩

              | cons k' ks' =>
                  let m' :=
                    match m with
                    | none => none
                    | some child => deleteNode child (k' :: ks')

                  have hm :
                      good_opt m' ∧
                        view_opt m' = view_opt m \ {k' :: ks'} := by
                    cases m with
                    | none =>
                        constructor
                        · trivial
                        · change
                            (∅ : Set (List Int)) =
                              (∅ : Set (List Int)) \ {k' :: ks'}
                          ext x
                          simp
                    | some child =>
                        have hc := hw.2.2.2
                        have hrec :=
                          ih child (nodeWeight_mid_lt v e l child r)
                            (k' :: ks') hc.1 hc.2 hks
                        simpa [m'] using hrec

                  let n := Node.mk v e l m' r
                  have hnwf : well_formed n := by
                    apply (wf_mk v e l m' r).mpr
                    exact ⟨hw.1, hw.2.1, hw.2.2.1, hm.1⟩

                  have hprefix :
                      prefixView v m' =
                        prefixView v m \ {v :: k' :: ks'} :=
                    prefix_diff v m m' (k' :: ks') hm.2

                  have hL :
                      v :: k' :: ks' ∉ view_opt l := by
                    intro hs
                    have ho := hw.2.1.2 (v :: k' :: ks') hs
                    change v < v at ho
                    omega

                  have hR :
                      v :: k' :: ks' ∉ view_opt r := by
                    intro hs
                    have ho := hw.2.2.1.2 (v :: k' :: ks') hs
                    change v > v at ho
                    omega

                  have hC :
                      v :: k' :: ks' ∉
                        (if e then ({[v]} : Set (List Int))

                      (prefixView v m) (prefixView v m')
